overview: Build a brick-built minifigure-style Jedi (inspired by the reference) with a white tunic, tan belt, blond hair/hood-like head shaping, and a blue lightsaber held in front. Scale: “bigfig/minifig statue” (about 12–15 bricks tall), simple SNOT-free where possible, stable and buildable from common bricks/plates in your inventory.

subassemblies.name: Display base
subassemblies.description: A small rectangular pedestal to stabilize the statue; mostly dark bluish gray/black plates and a few white tiles/plates for a clean edge.

subassemblies.name: Feet & lower legs (2x)
subassemblies.description: Two blocky feet with slightly stepped toes (using plates) and straight shins. White is primary color; add a couple tan/light bluish gray accents if desired to hint at boot/trim like the reference’s leg printing.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom left and bottom right (the legs/feet)

subassemblies.name: Hips/pelvis block
subassemblies.description: A compact core that locks both legs together and supports the torso. Use white bricks with a 1-plate-thick front layer where a belt will attach.
subassemblies.image_location: Lower center (between legs, just above the thighs)

subassemblies.name: Belt & tunic hem
subassemblies.description: A horizontal belt band around the waist: tan plates/tiles with small dark red/brown “pouches”/buckle detail at the front (use dark red pieces if tan tiles are limited).

subassemblies.name: Torso/robes
subassemblies.description: White torso block with a V-neck/robe wrap suggestion: create the V using layered plates/tiles (white with a few dark accents like dark bluish gray or dark tan lines). Keep the chest mostly smooth and bright like the reference.

subassemblies.name: Arms (2x)
subassemblies.description: Chunky white arms built as simple rectangular columns attached at shoulders. Pose both arms forward to hold the saber; one arm can be slightly higher to mimic the crossed grip.
subassemblies.image_location: Mid-right and mid-left (arms in front of torso)

subassemblies.name: Hands/grip block
subassemblies.description: A small, centered grip assembly between the arms using light bluish gray/dark bluish gray rounds/plates to suggest hands around the hilt. Designed to accept a vertical blade element.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-right (where the hands meet the lightsaber hilt)

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber hilt
subassemblies.description: Silver/gray cylindrical look: stack light bluish gray/dark bluish gray round elements and short plates to form a 1x1-ish column. Add a small black detail ring if available.
subassemblies.image_location: Right side of model, held in front of chest

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber blade
subassemblies.description: Blue blade using trans-clear bars/plates with blue plates/tiles behind (or trans pieces if available). Keep it straight and slightly taller than the head for the iconic silhouette.

subassemblies.name: Neck & head core
subassemblies.description: A small neck spacer (light bluish gray/white) supporting a tan/white head block. Face detail can be implied with minimal dark tiles/plates (eyes/brow) if you want a stylized look.

notes: Color-matching the reference: prioritize WHITE for robes/legs/arms; TAN for belt; light/dark bluish gray for saber hilt; BLUE accents for blade.
Keep the arms connected with simple studs-on-top shoulders so you can angle them forward; if joints aren’t available, use stepped plate offsets to approximate the pose.
If you don’t want to build a detailed face, make the head a clean tan/white block and put all character recognition into the blond “hair” shaping and lightsaber.
Use your abundant 2x4/2x3/2x2 bricks (3001/3003/3004/3002) for the internal core, and plates (3020/3021/3022/3023/3024/3710) for shaping and belt layering.
